_comment: Accepted npm audit advisories (scripts/security/audit-gate.mjs). Each entry: GHSA id, owner, a reason of at least 20 characters and an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days out). An expired entry fails the gate until someone re-decides it. Only HIGH/CRITICAL advisories fail the gate; lower ones are listed here only to record that they were looked at.

accepted.reason: Affects esbuild's development server only. drizzle-kit is the migration CLI run by an operator; Clearline never starts an esbuild dev server and no production bundle contains esbuild. [ASSUMPTION] re-check when drizzle-kit drops @esbuild-kit.

Missing bounds check only when a caller passes its own output buffer to uuid v3/v5/v6. Clearline never calls uuid; exceljs is used to READ uploaded workbooks. [ASSUMPTION] exceljs does not pass a caller buffer to v3/v5/v6; re-check on the next exceljs release.
